plugin.name: Kelaire_Note_Reader
plugin.author: Kelaire
plugin.purpose: Selectable, scrollable Aardwolf notes in a themed miniwindow

muclient.script:
require "themed_miniwindows" local WINDOW_ID = GetPluginID() local capturing = false local divider_count = 0 local note_lines = {} local my_window = nil
function StartNoteCapture(command) capturing = true divider_count = 0 note_lines = {} Send(command) end
function NoteDivider(name, line, wildcards) if not capturing then return end divider_count = divider_count + 1 if divider_count == 3 then capturing = false ShowCapturedNote() end end
function NoteLine(name, line, wildcards) if capturing and divider_count >= 1 and divider_count < 3 then -- The divider trigger runs first, so discard separator lines. if not line:match("^%s*~+%s*$") then table.insert(note_lines, line) end end end
function ShowCapturedNote() if my_window and my_window.id then my_window:delete() end my_window = ThemedTextWindow( WINDOW_ID, 80, 60, 740, 510, "Aardwolf Note Reader", "center", true, true, true, true, true, false, true, nil, nil, GetAlphaOption("output_font_name"), GetOption("output_font_height"), nil, nil, true ) for _, line in ipairs(note_lines) do my_window:add_text(ColoursToStyles(line), false) end -- text_rect.lua dispatches right clicks to textrect:rightClickMenu(). -- Override this instance only, leaving the shared library unchanged. local function copy_note_with_colours() local tr = my_window.textrect local selected = tr.copy_start_line ~= nil and tr.copy_end_line ~= nil local content = selected and tr:selected_text(true) or tr:getText() SetClipboard(content) ColourNote("yellow", "", selected and "Selected note text copied with colours." or "Entire note copied with colours.") end my_window.textrect.rightClickMenu = function(self, hotspot_id) copy_note_with_colours() end -- Also suppress the standard window menu outside the text rectangle. my_window.right_click_menu = function(self, hotspot_id) copy_note_with_colours() end my_window:set_scroll(1) my_window:show() my_window:bring_to_front() end
function NoteWindowCommand(action) action = (action or ""):lower() if action == "hide" then if my_window and my_window.id then my_window:hide() end elseif action == "show" then if my_window and my_window.id then my_window:show() my_window:bring_to_front() elseif #note_lines > 0 then ShowCapturedNote() end elseif action == "clear" then note_lines = {} capturing = false divider_count = 0 if my_window and my_window.id then my_window:delete(); my_window = nil end end end
function OnPluginDisable() capturing = false if my_window and my_window.id then my_window:hide() end end function OnPluginClose() if my_window and my_window.id then my_window:delete() end end
